title: Streets, Not Reputations: A Street-Level, Injury-Checked Cycling Risk Index for 300 European Cities
description: 300 European cities in 31 countries ranked on the cycling risk of their street networks, using one per-road risk model aggregated into street-network risk, journey risk and low-stress accessibility, with 90% rank intervals from 2,000 method respecifications and a 1 km network buffer that corrects administrative-boundary artefacts. In 18 cities with counter-measured exposure the index predicts serious-injury rates per passage (rate ratio 0.78 [0.70, 0.87] per 10 points; 0.76 [0.68, 0.86] on public-authority counters only); the association disappears within countries. The archive contains the preprint (PDF), the ranking website and an open data supplement. Validation counts include Telraam citizen-science data (CC BY-NC 4.0, used with permission) and the Berlin zählt network of ADFC Berlin. Factor weights of the underlying risk model are proprietary; the paper discloses factor names and directions only. Version 1 of this record is the earlier 219-city edition.
